FixedDamage20: Requests fixed 20 HP damage; shared fixed-damage and survival layers still apply.
FixedDamage40: Requests fixed 40 HP damage; shared fixed-damage and survival layers still apply.
FixedDamageHalfTargetHP: Requests the target's current HP divided by two, rounded to nearest integer.
FixedDamageUserLevel: Requests damage equal to current user level.
FixedDamageUserLevelRandom: Uniform integer request from floor(user level/2) through floor(3 user level/2), inclusive.
LowerTargetHPToUserHP: Fails when user HP is at least target HP; otherwise one hit requests their positive HP difference.
OHKO: Rejects a higher-level target and active nonignored Sturdy; its own accuracy threshold adds level difference; requests target maximum HP, subject to subsequent shared survival/absorption.
OHKOIce: Also rejects Ice targets; non-Ice users subtract ten from the OHKO accuracy threshold.
OHKOHitsUndergroundTarget: Extends the same OHKO behavior to underground semi-invulnerable targets.
DamageTargetAlly: During the damage-specific callback, near living allies of the target that can take indirect damage each lose floor(maximum HP/16), then each receives an HP-item check.
PowerHigherWithUserHP: Base power is floor(150 current user HP/maximum user HP), with minimum one.
PowerLowerWithUserHP: Floor(48 current user HP/maximum HP) uses thresholds 2,5,10,17,33 to request powers 200,150,100,80,40,20.
PowerHigherWithTargetHP: Base power is floor(120 current target HP/maximum target HP), with minimum one.
PowerHigherWithUserHappiness: Base power is floor(2 friendship/5), with minimum one.
PowerLowerWithUserHappiness: Base power is floor(2(255 minus friendship)/5), with minimum one.
PowerHigherWithUserPositiveStatStages: Power starts at twenty and adds twenty per positive battle-stat stage; negative stages contribute zero.
PowerHigherWithTargetPositiveStatStages: Power starts at sixty and adds twenty per positive target battle-stat stage, capped at two hundred.
PowerHigherWithUserFasterThanTarget: Effective-speed integer ratios at least 1,2,3,4 yield powers 60,80,120,150; lower ratios yield forty.
PowerHigherWithTargetFasterThanUser: Requests floor(25 effective target speed/effective user speed), bounded from one to one hundred fifty.
PowerHigherWithLessPP: Reads this move object's remaining PP after ordinary deduction; PP 0,1,2,3,at least4 map to powers 200,80,60,50,40.
PowerHigherWithTargetWeight: Effective target weight thresholds 10,25,50,100,200 kilograms yield 40,60,80,100,120; below ten yields twenty.
PowerHigherWithUserHeavierThanTarget: Effective user/target weight integer ratios at least2,3,4,5 yield60,80,100,120; lower ratios yield forty.
PowerHigherWithConsecutiveUse: Saves the previous Fury Cutter count before shared counter reset, increments it to the cap needed for at least power160, and doubles base power per retained successive step.
PowerHigherWithConsecutiveUseOnUserSide: Saves side counter before shared reset; only the first use in the round increments the side multiplier up to five; all uses mark the side as used.
RandomPowerDoublePowerIfTargetUndergroun: One start-of-use draw selects magnitude4..10 with weights1,2,4,6,4,2,1 and powers10,30,50,70,90,110,150; underground final multiplier doubles, Grassy Terrain halves it.
DoublePowerIfTargetHPLessThanHalf: Doubles base power when current target HP is no more than floor(maximum HP/2).
DoublePowerIfUserPoisonedBurnedParalyzed: Doubles for perceived poison/burn/paralysis; ordinary burn damage reduction is disabled only after generation5.
DoublePowerIfTargetAsleepCureTarget: Sleep doubles power only when no substitute or a bypass applies; after all hits a living affected nonsubstitute target with real sleep is cured.
DoublePowerIfTargetPoisoned: Perceived poison doubles power only when no substitute or a bypass applies.
DoublePowerIfTargetParalyzedCureTarget: Paralysis doubles power only when no substitute or a bypass applies; after all hits a living affected nonsubstitute target with real paralysis is cured.
DoublePowerIfTargetStatusProblem: A perceived status doubles power only when no substitute or a bypass applies.
DoublePowerIfUserHasNoItem: Doubles the power multiplier for absent current item or a remembered consumed Gem.
DoublePowerIfTargetUnderwater: Allows underwater semi-invulnerable hits and doubles the final multiplier only for the corresponding ongoing attack.
DoublePowerIfTargetUnderground: Allows underground hits, doubles the final multiplier for that ongoing attack, and halves the final multiplier in Grassy Terrain.
DoublePowerIfTargetInSky: Allows sky hits and doubles base power for Fly/Bounce/Sky Drop ongoing attacks or a carried Sky Drop target.
DoublePowerInElectricTerrain: Doubles base power for Electric Terrain only when the target is affected by terrain.
DoublePowerIfUserLastMoveFailed: Doubles base power from the user's retained last-round failure flag.
DoublePowerIfAllyFaintedLastTurn: Doubles base power only for a nonnegative side faint-round equal to current round minus one.
DoublePowerIfUserLostHPThisTurn: Doubles base power when the current target appears in the user's last-attacker list; that list's recording may include zero/substitute damage.
DoublePowerIfTargetLostHPThisTurn: Doubles base power when the target's current-round damage flag is set.
DoublePowerIfUserStatsLoweredThisTurn: Doubles base power when the user's current-round stat-lowering flag is set.
DoublePowerIfTargetActed: Doubles for a nonempty choice that is neither UseMove nor Shift, or for an already-moved target; newly switched empty choices do not qualify.
DoublePowerIfTargetNotActed: Doubles for an empty choice or an unmoved UseMove/Shift choice.
AlwaysCriticalHit: Overrides critical selection positively after earlier critical vetoes; it does not bypass those vetoes.
EnsureNextCriticalHit: Snatchable general effect sets Laser Focus to two without a local repeat-failure gate; later critical selection still has earlier vetoes.
StartPreventCriticalHitsAgainstUserSide: Snatchable general effect rejects a positive Lucky Chant and otherwise sets five; critical selection reads it as an early veto.
CannotMakeTargetFaint: The shared lethal-damage reduction uses this nonlethal predicate to leave one HP.
UserEnduresFaintingThisTurn: Uses the shared Protect probability/last-in-round contract but establishes Endure, consumed by lethal-damage reduction rather than attack rejection.
StartWeakenElectricMoves: Modern repeated positive field counter fails and successful field counter becomes five; old generations reject any battler's existing mark and otherwise mark the user.
StartWeakenFireMoves: Same timing/placement distinction as Mud Sport, but for Fire weakening.
StartWeakenPhysicalDamageAgainstUserSide: Snatchable; rejects an already-positive Reflect, then sets five or eight for active Light Clay.
StartWeakenSpecialDamageAgainstUserSide: Snatchable; rejects an already-positive Light Screen, then sets five or eight for active Light Clay.
StartWeakenDamageAgainstUserSideIfHail: Snatchable; requires effective Hail and absent positive Aurora Veil, then sets five or eight for active Light Clay.
RemoveScreens: Ignores screen damage reduction and clears opposing Light Screen, Reflect and Aurora Veil in the general callback; animation queries their current presence separately.
ProtectUser: Initializes ordinary Protect and otherwise uses shared Protect establishment; actual rejection is gated by the incoming move's protectability and earlier Unseen Fist bypass.
ProtectUserBanefulBunker: Initializes Baneful Bunker; the success-check consumer attempts contact poison only after shared contact and status gates.
ProtectUserFromDamagingMovesKingsShield: Initializes King's Shield; damaging protected contact attacks request Attack lowering by one in generation8 or two earlier.
ProtectUserFromDamagingMovesObstruct: Initializes Obstruct; damaging protected contact attacks request Defense lowering by two.
ProtectUserFromTargetingMovesSpikyShield: Initializes Spiky Shield; protected contact attacks can incur floor(user maximum HP/8), followed by an HP-item check.
ProtectUserSideFromDamagingMovesIfUserFi: Snatchable; requires first active turn and another pending UseMove/Shift action, then establishes side Mat Block.
ProtectUserSideFromStatusMoves: Rejects already-established Crafty Shield and last-in-round use, then establishes side protection consumed for status moves not targeting all.
ProtectUserSideFromPriorityMoves: Snatchable side Protect variant; modern side variants skip continuous-use random rejection but keep last-in-round failure.
ProtectUserSideFromMultiTargetDamagingMo: Snatchable side Protect variant; consumer uses target-data multiplicity rather than the number of actual living targets, and modern generations permit blocking status moves too.
RemoveProtections: Target effect clears five personal protections and four side protections, preserving Endure.
RemoveProtectionsBypassSubstitute: Adds explicit substitute bypass to the same clear-protection effect.
HoopaRemoveProtectionsBypassSubstituteLo: Requires Hoopa form1 and bypasses substitute; inherited dealing-damage callback requests user Defense minus1 unless the opposing party is fully fainted, then target main effect clears the same protection set.
RecoilQuarterOfDamageDealt: Requests nearest-integer one quarter of accumulated damage lost; shared recoil gates indirect-damage permission and Rock Head and ensures at least one.
RecoilThirdOfDamageDealt: Requests nearest-integer one third of accumulated damage lost, with the same shared recoil gates.
RecoilThirdOfDamageDealtParalyzeTarget: Adds a nonsubstitute paralysis attempt through central status eligibility to the same one-third recoil.
RecoilThirdOfDamageDealtBurnTarget: Adds a nonsubstitute burn attempt through central status eligibility to the same one-third recoil.
RecoilHalfOfDamageDealt: Requests nearest-integer one half of accumulated damage lost, with the same shared recoil gates.
EffectivenessIncludesFlyingType: For each defending type, combines the ordinary matchup contribution with Flying's contribution only when Flying data exists.
CategoryDependsOnHigherDamagePoisonTarge: At start of use, floors stage-adjusted attacking and target defending values, compares physical and special ratios, randomly breaks exact ties, changes contact with physical category, and inherits central poison qualification.
CategoryDependsOnHigherDamageIgnoreTarge: At start of use, compares floored stage-adjusted Attack and Special Attack; physical requires strictly greater Attack, otherwise special; inherited ability ignoring is set only for ordinary use.
UseUserDefenseInsteadOfUserAttack: Substitutes current user Defense and its stage as the attacking stat inputs; the remaining damage modifiers remain the ordinary attack-context modifiers.
UseTargetAttackInsteadOfUserAttack: Uses the target's Attack/stage, or its Special Attack/stage if the effective category is special; remaining damage calculations still have the ordinary user/target context.
UseTargetDefenseInsteadOfTargetSpDef: Uses current target Defense and its stage as defense inputs regardless of special category.
EnsureNextMoveAlwaysHits: Target main effect sets user Lock-On two and the target seat; shared per-hit success reads it before semi-invulnerability/accuracy but after initial target checks.
StartNegateTargetEvasionStatStageAndGhos: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing identification mark; ordinary accuracy removes only positive evasion and ordinary matchup applies the Ghost-immunity exception.
StartNegateTargetEvasionStatStageAndDark: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing identification mark; ordinary accuracy removes only positive evasion and ordinary matchup applies the Dark-immunity exception.
IgnoreTargetDefSpDefEvaStatStages: After ordinary accuracy modifier collection, replaces target evasion stage with zero including negative values; defense selection keeps ordinary stat value but neutral stage.
TypeIsUserFirstType: Reads the first current complete user type, falling back to original move type when absent; this bypasses ordinary base-type ability modification.
TypeDependsOnUserIVs: Reads persistent real IVs and registered icon-ordered nonpseudo nonNormal nonShadow types; modern power is unchanged, old bit accumulator starts at sixty and yields68,68,69,70.
TypeAndPowerDependOnUserBerry: Separates prefix-bearing active Berry admission, early complete-flag type selection, per-hit current-item power selection and end-of-use current-item consumption; absent per-hit current item fails before fallback power one.
TypeDependsOnUserPlate: Current active item is mapped to one of seventeen Plate types, with type-existence checks and Normal fallback.
TypeDependsOnUserMemory: Current active item is mapped to one of seventeen Memory types, with type-existence checks and Normal fallback.
TypeDependsOnUserDrive: Current active item is mapped to one of four Drive types, with type-existence checks and Normal fallback; animation independently rereads the current base type.
TypeDependsOnUserMorpekoFormRaiseUserSpe: Requires Morpeko persistent species or a Morpeko transform record; form1 uses registered Dark otherwise original type, with inherited user-Speed additional effect.
TypeAndPowerDependOnWeather: Early type uses effective weather, including identity NONE for Shadow Sky; per-hit base power doubles for any non-None effective weather, including Strong Winds with Normal type.
TypeAndPowerDependOnTerrain: Early type follows terrain regardless of grounding; per-hit base power doubles only for a nonempty terrain affecting the user.
TargetMovesBecomeElectric: Rejects an existing Electrify mark or a moved/non-UseMove/non-Shift target, then sets the current-round mark read by later type calculation.
NormalMovesBecomeElectric: Status form rejects duplicate Ion Deluge and last-in-round use; damaging form skips both local gates; general effect establishes the mark once and later type calculation converts Normal to Electric.
RedirectAllMovesToUser: Starts Follow Me at one, then increases beyond ally marks in traversal order; powder moves also establish Rage Powder; actual redirection prefers smaller positive marks.
RedirectAllMovesToTarget: Reflectable; starts target Spotlight at one and increases beyond its allies' marks; subsequent redirection has precedence over Follow Me.
CannotBeRedirected: A direct predicate bypasses redirection before Dragon Darts target expansion, unlike Stalwart/Propeller Tail's later bypass.
RandomlyDamageOrHealTarget: One start draw chooses damage40,80,120 or healing with probabilities40%,30%,10%,20%; healing needs healable target, requests floor(maximum HP/4) and changes animation/damaging predicate.
HealAllyOrDamageFoe: Heal Block dynamically restricts target class to Near Foe; start-of-use final target side determines healing; ally healing checks substitute/bypass and healability then restores half maximum HP.
CurseTargetOrLowerUserSpd1RaiseUserAtkDe: Ghost uses dynamic enemy target class and target Curse eligibility, commits Curse then floor(user maximum HP/2) and HP-item check; non-Ghost requires at least one permitted stat change and performs Speed minus1 then Attack plus1 then Defense plus1. Late Protean reconstruction has a distinct no-second-redirection path.
EffectDependsOnEnvironment: Start once captures terrain-first environment effect; after-all-hits once per living affected nonsubstitute target draws additional chance unless Sheer Force; declared flinch environments differ from actual flinch branches and Psychic animation identifier is CONFUSIO.
HitsAllFoesAndPowersUpInPsychicTerrain: Separately reads Psychic Terrain plus user affectedness when querying All Near Foes and when flooring three-halves base power.
TargetNextFireMoveDamagesTarget: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing Powder rejects existing mark, commits target Powder but announces user; later Fire usage can incur rounded quarter maximum HP and cancellation.
DoublePowerAfterFusionFlare: Saves field Fusion Flare before shared reset, doubles the power multiplier when saved true, and establishes Fusion Bolt in general effect.
DoublePowerAfterFusionBolt: Saves field Fusion Bolt before shared reset, doubles the power multiplier when saved true, and establishes Fusion Flare in general effect.
PowerUpAllyMove: Substitute-bypassing; rejects fainted/already-helped/moved/nonmove target; establishes Helping Hand read as power multiplier1.5; its semi-invulnerability permission is not an unconditional accuracy override.
CounterPhysicalDamage: Builds its target from an opposing recorded Counter seat, fails if no legal target, requests twice recorded Counter damage with zero promoted to one.
CounterSpecialDamage: Same targeting/failure rule for Mirror Coat, requesting twice recorded special damage with zero promoted to one.
CounterDamagePlusHalf: Builds target from the last recorded foe attacker, fails if none, requests floor(1.5 last HP lost from a foe) with zero promoted to one.
UserAddStockpileRaiseDefSpDef1: Snatchable; caps stockpile at three, commits the stockpile increase before independent Defense/Special Defense raises and records only successful raising operations.
PowerDependsOnUserStockpile: Requires nonzero stockpile and requests one hundred per stock; after all hits the user/affected-target gates precede message, opposing-all-fainted return can preserve stock, otherwise recorded boosts are centrally lowered then all stock records clear.
HealUserDependingOnUserStockpile: Healing/snatchable; requires stock and either healability or recorded boosts, restores quarter/half/full maximum HP for1/2/3 stocks, independently reverses recorded boosts then clears stock records.
GrassPledge: Defines Fire combo as opposing Sea of Fire with Fire type/animation, and Water combo as opposing Swamp without type/animation override; shared Pledge consumer interprets these values.
FirePledge: Defines Water combo as own Rainbow with Water type/animation, and Grass combo as opposing Sea of Fire without type/animation override.
WaterPledge: Defines Grass combo as opposing Swamp with Grass type/animation, and Fire combo as own Rainbow without type/animation override.
UseLastMoveUsed: Saves the earlier global move in usage-counter phase before replacing global history, filters its exact generation-sensitive effect set, then simple-calls with default target.
UseLastMoveUsedByTarget: Substitute-bypassing; requires current target last ordinary move to exist and carry CanMirrorMove; simple-calls that identity with target seat and no outer animation.
UseMoveTargetIsAboutToUse: Substitute-bypassing; requires unmoved UseMove/Shift choice with damaging nonexcluded move; sets Me First around default-target simple call, clears only after normal return.
UseMoveDependingOnEnvironment: Start-of-use selects registered terrain/environment identities with Tri Attack fallback; each affected target is announced then supplies its seat to the simple call.
UseRandomMove: Tries at most one thousand uniform draws over all registered move keys, rejecting exact effect set, CannotMetronome and Shadow original type; first success simple-calls with default target.
UseRandomMoveFromUserParty: Uses the complete same-side party, including partner team, excluding user index and modern eggs; keeps fainted donors and duplicate move entries; applies exact effect/Shadow filters then uniformly picks an entry.
UseRandomUserMoveIfAsleep: Builds current eligible slot-index pool through special candidate choice mode plus local effect exclusions; requires perceived sleep and nonempty pool, then calls a new temporary move toward the directly opposite seat.
BounceBackProblemCausingStatusMoves: Establishes Magic Coat for the shared target/no-target reflection consumers; reflection consumes its mark before the later direct hit.
StealAndUseBeneficialStatusMove: Establishes Snatch starting at one and includes self in the subsequent scan, so an otherwise lone mark becomes two; shared consumer chooses the smallest positive mark below one hundred and clears its choice target.
ReplaceMoveThisBattleWithTargetLastMoveU: Substitute-bypassing; rejects transformed user, absent own slot, absent/duplicate/excluded/Shadow target last ordinary move; replaces only first matching battle slot with full fresh PP and checks form without using copied move.
ReplaceMoveWithTargetLastMoveUsed: Same local slot/target conditions with the smaller exact exclusion set; commits new persistent slot first, then battle slot and feedback/form check; postcommit exceptions have no local rollback.
FleeFromBattle: Requires shared can-run and, for wild user, no living ally; general effect announces escape and sets decision three without the ordinary speed escape draw.
SwitchOutUserStatusMove: Wild path uses the escape gates and decision three; trainer path requires a reserve, then announces return, Pursuit, faint check, owner replacement selection, replacement, choice clear, Mold Breaker clear, entry notification and switched-seat append.
SwitchOutUserDamagingMove: End-of-use requires living user, positive successful-hit count, nonextinct opposing party, at least one original target not already switched and a reserve; then Pursuit/choice/replacement chain, independent of trapping and positive HP-loss amount.
LowerTargetAtkSpAtk1SwitchOutUser: Inherited target multi-stat lowering precedes end-of-use candidate selection from user or original reflection-marked target; positive outer hit count is still required, and ordinary single-target reflection leaves it zero.
SwitchOutUserPassOnEffects: Requires reserve before use and again at end, living user and positive hits; Pursuit and selection precede replacement with explicit Baton Pass subset then choice/Mold Breaker clear and entry notification.
SwitchOutTargetStatusMove: Substitute-bypassing and reflectable; target gate rejects nonignored Suction Cups/Ingrain and requires sole escapable nonhigher-level wild target or trainer reserve; wild main effect sets decision three, trainer after-move replacement is first eligible only and barred by existing switched seats.
SwitchOutTargetDamagingMove: Damage is not rejected by the status variant's preconditions; wild main escape reads current substitute durability and has no local survival/Suction Cups/Ingrain recheck; trainer switching separately rejects per-hit substitute and trapping guards.
BindTarget: After damage, only living nonsubstitute unbound target is initialized with counter5/6 uniformly or active Grip Claw counter8 modern/6 old, and current move/user seat.
BindTargetDoublePowerIfTargetUnderwater: Inherits Bind establishment, permits Dive targets, and doubles the final damage multiplier while the corresponding underwater two-turn move remains active.
TrapTargetInBattle: Reflectable status form rejects existing Mean Look or configured Ghost immunity and writes source seat; damaging form skips status failure and uses the additional-effect path with survival/substitute/existing/Ghost guards.
TrapTargetInBattleMainEffect: Uses the damage main callback, independent of additional-effect chance, and writes Mean Look only for living nonsubstitute unmarked nonexempt target.
TrapTargetInBattleLowerTargetDefSpDef1Ea: Status failure rejects existing Octolock and configured Ghost immunity; damaging form skips those gates, while target main effect writes Octolock source seat without the other local survival/substitute guards.
TrapUserAndTargetInBattle: Requires living endpoints, nonsubstitute nonexempt target and both local trapping queries false; writes only target Jaw Lock source, with shared trapped query recognizing both directions.
TrapAllBattlersInBattleForOneTurn: Rejects positive Fairy Lock and otherwise sets two; escape/switch consumers retain their earlier exemptions.
PursueSwitchingFoe: Only switching context doubles base power and makes this move's own accuracy check pass; shared prior target guards still apply.
UsedAfterUserTakesPhysicalDamage: Round preparation sets Shell Trap; actual use requires mark plus tookPhysicalHit; actual trigger requires opposing physical positive nonsubstitute HP loss while pending UseMove, then schedules Move Next and clears Quash.
UsedAfterAllyRoundWithDoublePower: Reads side Round as base-power doubling; general effect marks side Round then schedules first pending same-effect ally and clears its Quash.
TargetActsNext: Substitute-bypassing; rejects moved/non-UseMove/non-Shift target, preexisting Move Next and absent selected move object; writes Move Next true and Quash zero, preserving original command.
TargetActsLast: Rejects moved/nonmove target, absent selected object, already-maximal positive Quash or ordinary last priority without Quash; writes new maximum-plus-one and clears Move Next; modern scheduler ignores numeric order within Quash group.
TargetUsesItsLastUsedMoveAgain: Substitute-bypassing front gate uses target last ordinary move, current move-slot presence, exact exclusions, current multi-turn/pending-charge restrictions and last duplicate-slot PP; sets Instruct only. Shared consumer later uses current lastMoveUsed, real slot, ordinary flags and restores moved-round after return.
StartSlowerBattlersActFirst: Toggles positive Trick Room to zero or establishes five; scheduling reverses effective speed only within ordinary priority bracket.
HigherPriorityInGrassyTerrain: Adds one to data priority only when Grassy Terrain affects user at priority query time.
LowerPPOfTargetLastMoveBy3: Damage additional effect requires living nonsubstitute target and a current last-ordinary-move slot with positive finite PP; reduces by minimum of three and current PP through PP synchronization.
LowerPPOfTargetLastMoveBy4: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing; target admission requires same slot/finite-PP gate; target effect reduces by minimum of four and current PP through synchronization.
DisableTargetLastMoveUsed: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing; rejects existing Disable/no ordinary history/Aroma Veil/no suitable same-identity PP slot; writes five and identity then immediately checks curing item.
DisableTargetUsingSameMoveConsecutively: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing; rejects existing Torment/Aroma Veil, writes true then checks curing item; choice consumer applies immediately with instructed/special-use exceptions.
DisableTargetUsingDifferentMove: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing; rejects existing Encore, absent/unknown/excluded ordinary history, prepared Shell Trap, Aroma Veil and absent eligible same-identity PP slot; writes four/identity then curing-item check.
DisableTargetStatusMoves: Reflectable and substitute-bypassing; rejects existing Taunt/Aroma Veil/nonignored modern Oblivious; writes four then curing-item check.
DisableTargetHealingMoves: Reflectable without its own substitute bypass; rejects existing Heal Block/Aroma Veil; writes five then curing-item check; both move eligibility and healability consume it.
DisableTargetSoundMoves: Damage additional effect requires living nonsubstitute target; writes three even when already positive and only announces if previous count zero.
DisableTargetMovesKnownByUser: Snatchable; rejects existing own Imprison otherwise sets true; current living opposing bearers' current known moves are queried at selection/execution time.
DoesNothingCongratulations: General effect displays the wild user's or trainer owner's congratulation and commits no substantive gameplay state.
DoesNothingFailsIfNoAlly: Substitute-bypassing; whole-use failure requires no living user ally; success itself commits no substantive gameplay state.
DoesNothingUnusableInGravity: Gravity eligibility rejects use; otherwise general callback only displays no-effect feedback.
SetUserTypesBasedOnEnvironment: Snatchable type-change gate uses raw ability identity, terrain mapping with registered-type priority, otherwise environment/Normal fallback; requires another current type before committing one type.
SetUserTypesToResistLastAttack: Substitute-bypassing; user must permit type change and target have used-move/type history with nonpseudo type; builds registered nonpseudo user-absent resisting/immunity types, uniformly picks one and replaces user types.
SetUserTypesToTargetTypes: Substitute-bypassing; user must permit change, target complete type list must be nonempty, and base current list or extra-type record must differ; copies current types through shared normalization.
SetUserTypesToUserMoveType: Snatchable; user must permit change; modern first slot only or all old slots contribute nonpseudo user-absent original types, deduplicated, then uniformly selected.
SetTargetTypesToPsychic: Reflectable; target must permit change, Psychic data must exist and another current type remain; shared setter replaces types with Psychic.
SetTargetTypesToWater: Same target/type-existence/other-type gate, replacing with Water.
AddGhostTypeToTarget: Reflectable; requires target type-change permission, registered Ghost and no existing Ghost; replaces the single extra-type record with Ghost.
AddGrassTypeToTarget: Reflectable; same gate for Grass and replaces the single extra-type record.
UserLosesFireType: Whole-use admission requires current Fire; reached after-all-hits callback sets Burn Up and feedback without target unaffected/survival tests; shared type query omits Fire without changing persistent types.
UserSwapBaseAtkDef: Snatchable; snapshots current Attack and Defense getters, writes the raw Attack/Defense fields exchanged, toggles Power Trick then feedback; Wonder Room changes reads but not write destinations.
UserTargetSwapBaseSpeed: Substitute-bypassing; swaps raw Speed fields between user/target, preserving their independent stages and modifiers.
UserTargetAverageBaseAtkSpAtk: Reads both raw Attack and Special Attack pairs before any write; independently floors pair averages, writes each common average to both endpoints then feedback.
UserTargetAverageBaseDefSpDef: Reads both current Defense/Special Defense getters before writes, independently floors averages, writes same-named raw fields on both endpoints; Wonder Room affects getters only.
AddMoneyGainedFromBattle: General effect adds five times current level only for player-owned user, but displays coin feedback for any user.
DoubleMoneyGainedFromBattle: General effect sets Happy Hour for a nonopposing user; repeat retains true and feedback does not itself credit player balance.
UserMakeSubstitute: Snatchable; rejects existing substitute and HP not strictly above minimum-one quarter-maximum cost; initialization spends cost without damage flags then checks healing item; general effect clears trapping count/move and installs saved substitute durability.
UserSwapsPositionsWithAlly: Whole-use gate requires exactly one living nearby ally of the same owner; successful positional swap notifies both positions rather than complete battle entry.
BurnAttackerBeforeUserActs: Preparation sets Beak Blast and feedback; shared opposing-contact reaction occurs after HP/damage records and gates actual contact, contact-effect permission and central burn eligibility; attacker substitute can expose a wrong-context local exception after damage commits.
SetTargetAbilityToSimple: Reflectable; destination data existence and target raw unstoppable/Truant/already-Simple gates; commits ability then feedback, losing old ability and gaining checks in order.
SetTargetAbilityToInsomnia: Same local operation for Insomnia, preserving exact destination/already-identity gates.
SetUserAbilityToTargetAbility: Substitute-bypassing; user raw ability must be replaceable; target must have different gainable ability outside Power of Alchemy/Receiver/Trace/Wonder Guard; commits user then old-loss/new-gain checks.
SetTargetAbilityToUserAbility: Reflectable; user must have gainable ability outside Power of Alchemy/Receiver/Trace; target must be replaceable and not Truant; no local same-ability or user Wonder Guard exclusion; commits target then loss/gain checks.
UserTargetSwapAbilities: Substitute-bypassing; each raw ability must exist/be replaceable/gainable and not Wonder Guard; old generations reject same identity; commits both first, then user loss,target loss,user gain,target gain; shared clause may reject earlier.
NegateTargetAbility: Reflectable; target unstoppable or already-suppressed rejects; writes Gastro Acid true and Truant false, feedback then old-loss callback with suppression flag, without new-gain callback.
NegateTargetAbilityIfTargetActed: Target main callback rejects substitute/already-suppressed/unstoppable; accepts item choice or moved UseMove/Shift only, then same suppression commit/loss sequence.
IgnoreTargetAbility: Shared counter reset happens first; only ordinary usage establishes global Mold Breaker itself; ordinary active Mold Breaker-family user can establish it separately earlier.
StartUserAirborne: Gravity-disallowed and snatchable; rejects Ingrain/Smack Down/positive Magnet Rise, establishes five; separate grounding/query rules can still make airborne false.
StartTargetAirborneAndAlwaysHitByMoves: Gravity-disallowed/reflectable; rejects Ingrain/Smack Down/existing mark, four rooted species and Mega Gengar; establishes three consumed by ordinary accuracy early-return, not independent OHKO accuracy.
HitsTargetInSky: Permits sky semi-invulnerable hits without adding power or grounding.
HitsTargetInSkyGroundsTarget: Overrides Ground-versus-Flying single contribution to neutral; allows sky hits; after all hits rejects fainted/unaffected/substitute/Sky Drop, requires actual airborne or Fly/Bounce, marks Smack Down and cancels Fly/Bounce and pending choice, clears Magnet Rise/Telekinesis.
StartGravity: Rejects positive Gravity, establishes five, then cancels living battlers' specific sky attacks and pending choices, clears Magnet Rise/Telekinesis/carried Sky Drop references with feedback.
TransformUserIntoTarget: Rejects already-transformed user and transformed/illusion target; animation changes displayed creature before target effect; shared transform copies current values/types/ability/stages and new moves at five PP, preserving HP/level and applying only old-ability-loss callback.
UserTakesTargetItem: After all hits requires nonwild living user, affected nonsubstitute target, target item and empty user, transferability at both ends and nonignored Sticky Hold; commits recipient current item first, updates wild permanence conditionally, removes donor temporarily or permanently then triggers recipient held item.
TargetTakesUserItem: Modern substitute bypass; user must have transferable item and target be empty/permit it; commits target current item, conditionally updates wild permanence, removes user item and triggers target; no Sticky Hold gate.
UserTargetSwapItems: Rejects wild user, both empty, four transferability combinations and nonignored target Sticky Hold; writes each current item with choice-lock/lightening changes, wild initial-item update is one-sided, then triggers user item before target item.
RestoreUserConsumedItem: Snatchable; requires recycle record and empty current item; restores current/conditional wild initial item, clears recycle/pickup/sequence then triggers held item, without inventory increment.
RemoveTargetItem: Modern transferable target item increases rounded base power even through Sticky Hold/substitute; after-all-hits removal separately requires living nonwild user, affected nonsubstitute target and nonignored Sticky Hold, and preserves initial item through temporary removal.
